{
  "server": {
    "port": 4747,
    "insecurePort": 4748,
    "host": "127.0.0.1",
    "advertiseAddr": null,
    "tls": {
      "enabled": false,
      "certPath": "",
      "keyPath": ""
    },
    "allowedOrigins": []
  },
  "storePath": "/var/lib/legion",
  "workerConfigPath": "/etc/legion/workers/",
  "workerCheckSeconds": 2,
  "evalThreads": 4,
  "schedulingPolicy": "bin_pack",
  "defaultPriority": 50,
  "rolloutRetentionDays": 30,
  "kvDebounceMs": 500,
  "schedulerSettings": {
    "plan_conflict_max_retries": 3
  },
  "taskResourceDefaults": null,
  "customResources": null,
  "persistence": {
    "type": "local_disk",
    "streaming": {
      "replicaUrl": "",
      "syncInterval": "1s",
      "lease": {
        "provider": "none",
        "key": "leases/default/primary.json",
        "ttlSeconds": 15,
        "renewIntervalSeconds": 5,
        "objectStorage": {
          "bucket": "",
          "region": "auto",
          "endpoint": null,
          "accessKeyId": null,
          "secretAccessKey": null
        }
      }
    },
    "raft": {
      "nodeId": "mgr-a",
      "bootstrap": true,
      "peers": [
        "mgr-a",
        "mgr-b",
        "mgr-c"
      ],
      "joinTokenTtlSeconds": 900,
      "dataDir": "/var/lib/legion/raft",
      "topology": "single",
      "advertiseAddr": null,
      "clusterSecret": null,
      "joinToken": null,
      "expectedVoters": null,
      "snapshotEntries": 10000,
      "forceNewCluster": false,
      "heartbeatIntervalMs": 250,
      "electionTimeoutMinMs": 600,
      "electionTimeoutMaxMs": 1200
    }
  },
  "workloadIdentity": {
    "enabled": false,
    "issuer": null,
    "jwksPath": "/.well-known/jwks.json",
    "signingAlg": "ES256",
    "defaultTtl": "15m",
    "rotationAge": "24h",
    "subTemplate": "{region}:{job}:{group}:{task}",
    "nodeIdentities": [],
    "controlPlaneBindings": []
  },
  "acl": {
    "enabled": false,
    "auditOnly": false,
    "loginTtl": "24h",
    "tokenMaxTtl": null,
    "authMethods": [],
    "jwksRefreshInterval": "5m"
  },
  "artifacts": {
    "allowedSchemes": [
      "https",
      "s3",
      "oci",
      "git",
      "file"
    ],
    "auth": [],
    "containerImageDesugar": false
  },
  "exec": {
    "enabled": true
  },
  "telemetry": {
    "enabled": true,
    "port": null
  },
  "edgeBoot": {
    "enabled": false,
    "defaultTicketTtl": "5m",
    "maxTicketTtl": "1h",
    "maxProvisionalPerNode": 32
  },
  "heartbeat": {
    "adaptive": true,
    "targetRatePerSecond": 2500.0,
    "minInterval": "2s",
    "maxInterval": "120s",
    "missedBeatsBeforeLost": 5,
    "headroom": 2.0
  },
  "liveness": {
    "batchWindow": "0ms",
    "failoverGrace": "60s",
    "digestInterval": "1s",
    "peerDigestGrace": "30s",
    "checkpointInterval": "30s"
  },
  "encryption": {
    "enabled": true,
    "rootKey": {
      "provider": "file",
      "path": null,
      "var": "LEGION_ROOT_KEY",
      "command": [],
      "timeout": "10s"
    },
    "dataKeyRotationAge": "720h"
  }
}
